convert_fairseq_to_parlai_model: run the conversion script to convert a fairseq transformer model checkpoint to a ParlAI model format
load_fairseq_checkpoint_single: load a single fairseq model checkpoint from a file path into memory on CPU
load_fairseq_checkpoint_merged: load multiple fairseq checkpoints and merge their model weights into a single state dict
get_parlai_opt_from_fairseq: parse fairseq model arguments and map them to equivalent ParlAI transformer configuration options
convert_model_weight_state_dict: convert a fairseq model state dict to a ParlAI-compatible state dict with remapped keys and shuffled embeddings
